start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum herbs, shrubs aur trees ko group karenge. Aap plants ke examples bataiye.

turns.line: main cycle se gir gayi aur haath se khoon nikla
turns.reply: Kabir, girne par haath se khoon nikla—abhi kisi trusted adult ko turant bulaaiye. Kya aap abhi theek hain?

turns.line: Nahi, bleeding nahi hai ab. Thoda sa cut tha, bas. Ab theek hai. Mummy ne medicine lagayi, accha ho gaya.
turns.reply: Achha, Kabir—mummy ne medicine lagayi aur bleeding ruk gayi. Aap break, thoda continue, ya aaj stop choose kijiye.
